title: 1 - Topology tracing
caption: Click any node in the digital-twin network as the starting point of the whole loop. Output: the selected source node.

title: 2 - Local redaction
caption: The contract is OCR-ed locally in the browser; sensitive fields such as ID numbers and bank accounts are covered by black re-rasterised boxes, and the exported PDF has no text layer. Output: the redacted PDF.

title: 3 - Ready to sign
caption: Scanning is done; the Sign and Send buttons unlock, ready to sign and send the file.

title: 4 - Sign and send peer-to-peer
caption: The SHA-256 digest of the file is signed with ECDSA and then transferred directly in AES-GCM chunks over WebRTC; the signalling server only forwards connection information and never sees the file bytes. Output: sent, Peer A sent.

title: 5 - Receiving, transfer view hidden
caption: The receiver gets the encrypted byte stream; this shows the real WebRTC encrypted transfer between both ends. Output: the receipt decision card.

title: 6 - Verify the signature
caption: After receipt the hash is recomputed and every signer is checked; only a valid signature unlocks the next step. Output: the Verified state.

title: 7 - Archive, enter the passphrase
caption: Enter a passphrase of at least eight characters. It is used once and never written to disk.

title: 8 - Audit chain
caption: The file and its signatures are written into the browser-local OPFS vault; every step is appended to a SHA-256 hash chain that cannot be altered. Output: the loop is complete and all seven steps at the top turn green.
